🐧 Support Proton Environment

Yes, I am done implementing the transparent background support for Linux. Now, I have started adding a specific background for it.

As most game players are using Proton 10 as their compatibility layer, the code may detect the platform as Windows 🪟. However, Proton exposes a wine\_get\_version function to retrieve the Proton version. This function is only callable within a Proton environment.
